title: Circulating Tumor DNA in Oligoprogressive Prostate Cancer Treated With Stereotactic Radiotherapy: A Prespecified Secondary Analysis of a Nonrandomized Clinical Trial.
snippet: Stereotactic body radiotherapy (SBRT) is increasingly used for oligoprogressive prostate cancer, but the duration of disease control is highly variable. To evaluate time to progression based on circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) prior to SBRT.
